body:
Parent: #2180
Depends on: #2692

## 原子目标

只消费 #2692 canonical rerun/cleanup receipt，执行 comment rerun 全仓 scanner、父票反例/mutation、parallel isolation、DB/revision/timeline/outbox/public-admin/queue/cache/notification parity与 privacy治理，并签发 terminal acceptance receipt。该 issue 不修改 rerun writer、timeline、edge verifier或产品 comment/moderation/privacy语义。

## 输入与输出

- #2692 verified rerun/cleanup receipt。
- #2177–#2179 command/timeline/edge receipts。
- 新增 `tools/test/check-comment-fixture-rerun-governance.mjs`、`tests/tools/comment-fixture-rerun-governance.test.mjs`。
- 输出 `.tmp/test-evidence/comment-rerun-acceptance.json`，schema `fsusblog.comment-rerun-acceptance.v1`。

## 必须交付

1. Scanner覆盖 C#/JS/TS/shell/workflow/package/config/docs，识别 legacy actors/private attrs/direct writes/manual thread、first-row/count-only、single-comment-all-states、status-only timeline、nullifier/policy bypass、compat writer/helper/feature flag/warning与 second writer。
2. Mutation fixtures稳定杀死：legacy/privacy/revision/thread/public visibility/timeline/appeal/nullifier/notification/rerun/direct depth bypass，以及 direct SQL+fake revision/outbox、fake attrs、edge warning与 old helper forwarding。
3. 对同一 canonical plan验证 DB/current revision/history/timeline/outbox、public/admin/queue/cache/notification与 privacy proof verdict完全一致。
4. 同 plan重复 rerun不累计 revision/event/outbox/audit/notification/nullifier；parallel profiles只清 operation-owned facts，无 article/auth/security/non-owned comment污染。
5. Ordinary receipts/logs/traces/screenshots/CI artifacts不含 private exact attrs、credential/nullifier secret或 comment正文，除 controlled digest/key。
6. Missing/partial/stale/cross-source/profile/comment/plan/generation receipt或 identity tamper fail closed。
7. Acceptance receipt记录 source、input command/timeline/edge/rerun refs、scanner/mutation/isolation/parity/privacy results、warnings与 contentDigest。
8. status=accepted仅在 exact rerun、violations=0、all mutations killed、consumer parity exact、privacy leaks=0、warnings=0 时签发。

## 固定约束

- #2692 与 #2177–#2179 是实现/事实 owners；本 issue只验证。
- 只允许修改 scanner、mutation fixtures、evidence generator/tests。
- 禁止 allowlist、manual projection、disable policy、自动修复或减少 edge/consumer set。
- 不修改 #1794。

## 必须测试

1. 合法 canonical rerun receipt正向。
2. input missing/stale/tamper/cross-source/profile/plan失败。
3. 父票十一项及 legacy/private/direct/thread/count mutations全部被杀死。
4. DB/revision/timeline/outbox/public-admin/queue/cache/notification verdict drift失败。
5. rerun第二次累计业务/edge/nullifier facts失败。
6. article/auth/security/non-owned comments被修改失败。
7. private attrs/credential/nullifier/comment正文泄漏失败。
8. renamed actor/helper/compat/second writer被 scanner识别。
9. warning/unknown/not-observed不能 accepted。
10. terminal receipt/scanner/mutation result tamper失败。

## 验收条件

- [ ] `node tools/test/check-comment-fixture-rerun-governance.mjs` 返回0 violations。
- [ ] `node --test tests/tools/comment-fixture-rerun-governance.test.mjs tests/tools/comment-fixture-rerun.test.mjs` 通过。
- [ ] legacy actor/private attrs/direct SQL/manual thread/first-row/count-only/compat/second writer残留为0。
- [ ] DB/timeline/outbox/public-admin/queue/cache/notification/privacy对 canonical plan完全一致。
- [ ] Rerun幂等、owned cleanup、non-owned保护与 privacy通过。
- [ ] `fsusblog.comment-rerun-acceptance.v1` accepted、warnings=0、可独立重算。

## 非目标

- 不实现或修复 #2692/#2177–#2179。
- 不测试 comment UI或增加内容/规模/语言变体。
- 不修复测试发现的产品缺陷。
title: evidence(test-fixtures): comment rerun isolation 与终态 evidence
